name: BarChart
description: A dependency-free SVG bar chart card whose bars grow in with a staggered spring-like ease, with nice-rounded gridlines, an axis, value labels and a hover/keyboard tooltip. Vertical or horizontal, sized to its container via ResizeObserver.
a11yNotes: The SVG is aria-hidden; a visually hidden <table> with a caption, column headers and row headers exposes every label/value pair to assistive tech. The plot is a single focusable role="group" with an accessible name: Arrow keys (and Home/End) step through bars, showing the tooltip and announcing "Label: value" in a polite live region; Escape clears. Focus is shown with a 2px outline. Under prefers-reduced-motion the bars render at full size without the grow-in.

propsApi.name: values
propsApi.description: Bar values aligned with labels; numeric strings and comma separated strings are parsed. Negative or invalid values render as 0.

propsApi.name: orientation
propsApi.description: Column chart or horizontal bar chart.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Card title; also names the chart and the fallback table.

propsApi.name: showGrid
propsApi.description: Show dashed gridlines and value-axis ticks.

propsApi.name: showValues
propsApi.description: Show a value label at the end of each bar.

propsApi.name: barRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the bar ends in px.

propsApi.name: barGap
propsApi.description: Fraction of each band left empty between bars (0–0.8).

propsApi.name: stagger
propsApi.description: Delay between consecutive bars growing in, in ms.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Plot height in px (width follows the container).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
